audience: event organizers who publish programmes, speakers and registrations in eventOne

useCases.title: Build the programme of an event
useCases.text: Read the event, then list its days, timeslots and sessions to see the programme by day and time.

useCases.title: List the speakers and tracks
useCases.text: List the speakers with their titles and featured flags, and the tracks with their colours, for one event.

useCases.title: Check registration orders and promo codes
useCases.text: List the registration orders filtered by status or date range, and list the promo codes with their limits and expiry.

useCases.title: Find an event and its organization
useCases.text: Search events by text across the platform, then list the events of one organization by its slug.

useCases.title: Review session attendance
useCases.text: Get the recorded headcount for each session of an event, and list the rooms with their capacity.
